authorization_handoff_note: the canonical byte stream of the handoff is not an artefact in the repository. Its hash is RECORDED as given, never asserted as verified.
what_this_audit_may_do: read code, hashes, checkpoint manifests and already-committed primary raw outputs
run pure parsers (AST), symbolic algebra on 2x2 maps, and offline reductions over already-stored arrays
what_this_audit_may_not_do: call the simulation runner or advance the model by one step
create a new physical state or generate a trajectory
numerically scan new radii, windows, lags or readers
engine_start_definition: if a command would import the runtime and advance dynamical state, it is an engine start and is forbidden. Any engine start terminates the programme as AUDIT_SCOPE_VIOLATION.
enforcement: eefca_sentinel.py installs a fail-closed import guard BEFORE any other import in eefca_audit.py and in eefca_verify.py. Every runtime module (edlab, ppai_engine, ppai_core, domc_core, chmr_core, etpc_core, etpc_run, etpc_gates) raises RuntimeError('AUDIT_SCOPE_VIOLATION') on import.
retrospective_status: FULLY RETROSPECTIVE with respect to the four ETPC endpoint values, their confidence intervals and their p-values, which were already known and quoted in the parent report before this audit began. This is declared, not concealed. The only element still genuinely sealed is the held-out geometry, which is not touched.
self_audit_declaration: the author of ETPC and the author of this audit are the same agent. Every finding below is adversarial against the agent's own prior work.

questions.Q1: did the executed z operator have the algebraic properties the parent claimed for it?
questions.Q2: was the executed endpoint the endpoint that was authorized?
questions.Q3: is the sign of the executed endpoint derivable from the model, or was it asserted?
questions.Q4: is a further confirmatory programme scientifically eligible, and under what exact conditions?

phases.A: provenance, raw inventory, disclosure of already-known outcomes, engine-start sentinel
phases.B: mandatory ETPC corrigendum B1-B7: exact start ledger, corrected R and T tables, corrected claim ledger, validity split
phases.C: operator conformance audit: the 2x2 mean map, its square, its inverse, the invariant inventory, the oracle audit
phases.D: exact endpoint reconstruction: code-to-equation registry and scalar reconstruction against the committed analysis
phases.E: exact functional congruence: arrow-by-arrow chain and derivative ladder
phases.F: frozen retrospective spatial decomposition, IF the data permit

forbidden_moves: rewriting a parent output or a parent freeze (corrigenda are append-only)
opening the held-out geometry's outputs, or running it under any endpoint
selecting a reader, radius, annulus, lag, normalisation, sign or threshold because it makes the existing effect look favourable
converting the failed one-sided primary hypothesis into a confirmatory pass via a post-hoc two-sided test
opening ownership, individuality, closure, turnover persistence, autonomy, metabolism, organismality, reproduction, heredity, life, consciousness or AGI
note_on_code_sha256: frozen after the audit and the verifier were final; re-checked by SHA256SUMS
